originalTitle: Is Vistra Stock Engineered To Make You Money?

content:

Vistra (VST) stock lost 26.8% over the past year, against a 15.0% gain for the S&P 500. The power company continued to buy back its shares all the same. Its diluted share count is 10% lower than three years ago, leaving each remaining share with a larger piece of Vistra’s profit. So how much has that shrinking share count done for each Vistra share?

Vistra Earns More Per Share Than Three Years Ago

Over the three years to June 2026, Vistra’s earnings per share grew 17.4% a year, against 11.6% a year for its net income. Most of the difference comes from the smaller share count. With the profit split among fewer shares, each share’s portion grows faster than the profit itself.

The climb was not smooth. Earnings per share fell sharply in the twelve months to June 2024 before recovering. In the latest twelve months, net income fell 7.1% and earnings per share fell 5.6%. Fewer shares meant a smaller per-share decline, but it was still a fall.

Vistra is still buying. Net of stock pay to employees, its buybacks over the last twelve months came to 2.1% of its market value. Management said on the August 7, 2026 call that Vistra has retired about 171 million shares since November 2021. The company paid about $38 a share on average, against a close of $146.66 on October 27, 2026.

Over the twelve months to June 2026, Vistra paid for its buyback and dividend out of the cash its business produced. Free cash flow covered both 1.4 times. That cash comes from two businesses, power generation and retail. On the August 7 call, management said its generation business delivered about $994 million of adjusted EBITDA in the second quarter, against about $593 million a year earlier, and its retail business about $773 million.

Vistra kept 19.4% of its revenue as operating income over the last twelve months, against 18.5% for the S&P 500. Capital spending was 56% of its cash from operations over the same period. The buyback is paid from what is left after that spending, not from cash on hand.

Debt is the main risk to Vistra’s buyback. At the end of June 2026, Vistra’s debt exceeded its cash by $19.5 billion, or about 3.0 times its EBITDA over the previous twelve months. Its operating income covered interest expense 3.9 times over the same period. Over the three years in which the share count fell, total debt rose from $12.3 billion to $19.9 billion. Management said Vistra has investment-grade credit ratings from two of the major agencies.

The live worry for holders is power prices in Texas . Management said that prices in the Texas market have softened, and that 2027 adjusted EBITDA was trending toward the lower end of its $7.4 billion to $7.8 billion range. That range leaves out the pending Cogentrix acquisition and the Meta power deal. With softer prices there, Vistra could have less cash for the buyback. Management also forecast more than $10 billion of available cash across 2026 and 2027 combined, and has set aside about $3 billion of it for shareholders through buybacks and dividends.

So far the buyback works per share. Earnings per share grew faster than net income over three years, and the business’s own cash paid for the buyback in the latest twelve months. Vistra’s debt could undo it: total debt rose as the share count fell. Vistra’s free cash flow against what it hands back to shareholders is the number to watch when the company reports third-quarter results, expected in November 2026.

Vistra (VST) 股票在过去一年下跌了 26.8%，而标准普尔 500 指数则上涨了 15.0%。尽管如此，该电力公司仍继续回购其股票。其稀释后的股份数量比三年前减少了 10%，使得剩余的每一股都能从瑞致达的利润中获得更大的份额。那么，瑞致达每股股票数量的减少对每股收益有多大影响呢？

瑞致达每股盈利高于三年前

截至 2026 年 6 月的三年里，瑞致达的每股收益每年增长 17.4%，而净利润每年增长 11.6%。大部分差异来自于较小的份额数量。随着利润分配到较少的股份中，每股份额的增长速度快于利润本身。

攀登并不顺利。截至 2024 年 6 月的 12 个月内，每股收益大幅下降，随后又恢复。最近 12 个月，净利润下降 7.1%，每股收益下降 5.6%。股票数量减少意味着每股跌幅较小，但仍然是下跌。

瑞致达仍在买入。扣除向员工支付的股票工资后，过去 12 个月的回购额达到其市值的 2.1%。管理层在 2026 年 8 月 7 日的电话会议上表示，自 2021 年 11 月以来，瑞致达已退役约 1.71 亿股股票。该公司平均支付每股约 38 美元，而 2026 年 10 月 27 日收盘价为 146.66 美元。

截至 2026 年 6 月的 12 个月中，瑞致达用其业务产生的现金支付了回购和股息。自由现金流覆盖两者的1.4倍。这些现金来自两项业务：发电和零售。在 8 月 7 日的电话会议上，管理层表示，其发电业务第二季度调整后 EBITDA 约为 9.94 亿美元，而去年同期约为 5.93 亿美元，零售业务约为 7.73 亿美元。

过去 12 个月，瑞致达将其收入的 19.4% 作为营业收入，而标准普尔 500 指数的这一比例为 18.5%。同期资本支出占其运营现金的 56%。回购是从支出后剩余的资金中支付的，而不是从手头的现金中支付。

债务是瑞致达回购的主要风险。截至 2026 年 6 月底，瑞致达的债务超过现金 195 亿美元，约为过去 12 个月 EBITDA 的 3.0 倍。其营业收入是同期利息支出的3.9倍。在股票数量下降的三年里，债务总额从 123 亿美元增加到 199 亿美元。管理层表示，瑞致达拥有两家主要机构的投资级信用评级。

持有者最担心的是德克萨斯州的电价。管理层表示，德克萨斯州市场的价格已经走软，2027 年调整后的 EBITDA 正趋向 74 亿至 78 亿美元范围的下限。该范围不包括即将进行的 Cogentrix 收购和 Meta 电力交易。由于价格疲软，瑞致达用于回购的现金可能会减少。管理层还预测 2026 年和 2027 年的可用现金合计将超过 100 亿美元，并通过回购和股息为股东留出约 30 亿美元。

到目前为止，回购按每股进行。三年来每股收益的增长速度快于净利润的增长速度，并且公司自己的现金用于最近十二个月的回购。瑞致达的债务可能会扭转这一局面：总债务随着股票数量的下降而上升。瑞致达预计将于 2026 年 11 月公布第三季度业绩，该公司的自由现金流与返还给股东的现金流量是值得关注的数字。

瑞致达再次陷入困境会对您的计划产生什么影响？

当一只股票占你所持股票的很大一部分时，下跌对你造成的伤害最大，而出售它来分散风险可能会带来巨额税款。我们的合作伙伴咨询公司提供免费的策略审查，以评估如何在大头寸下设置底线并以较少的税收平仓。
